subject: dsa
title: Word Break
summary: A position is reachable if some dictionary word ends there, starting from an earlier reachable position. Sweep left to right; if you can reach the end of the string, it breaks into words.
problem: Given a string and a dictionary, decide whether the string can be segmented into a sequence of dictionary words.

steps.caption: Can 'leetcode' be cut into dictionary words {leet, code}? Mark a position reachable if a dictionary word ends there from an earlier reachable spot.
Start from the beginning, which counts as reachable. 'leet' is in the dictionary and covers indices 0 through 3.
So everything up to index 3 is segmentable. Now continue the search from index 4.
From index 4, 'code' is in the dictionary and covers indices 4 through 7.
That reaches the end of the string. 'leet' + 'code' segments it fully, so the answer is true.
